matches.rationale: Pred_id 1 identifies the exact inconsistency between Lemma 3.1's stated condition (δ_p > 5||E||) and Theorem 2.1's condition (4||E|| < δ_p), noting that the lemma cannot establish the theorem over the gap interval. This directly detects the strict vs. non-strict inequality inconsistency described in gt_id 1.

None of the findings identify the ambiguity about whether max_{z ∈ Γ_1} is over the boundary (∂Γ_1) or interior of the rectangle. Pred_id 4 discusses Theorem 2.3 but concerns a different issue (best rank-p approximation claim), not the notation ambiguity about the contour maximum.
